skills.name: Basic
skills.desc: Deals Direct DMG of 40% ATK to a single target.

skills.name: Ultimate
skills.desc: Deals Direct DMG of 90% ATK to the target's row. If own SPD (×0.9) exceeds the target's SPD, steals the SPD difference as [Super Speed]. Grants [Super Speed] to own row for 2 turns.

skills.name: Ultra-Ultimate
skills.desc: Deals Direct DMG of 90% > 125% ATK to the target's row. If own SPD (×0.9) exceeds the target's SPD, steals the SPD difference as [Super Speed]. Grants [Super Speed] to own row for 2 turns.

skills.name: Passive
skills.desc: Permanently increases own HP by (+20). At the start of battle, grants [Specialized Acceleration] (increases SPD by 20%; if the main target's SPD is lower than Zombieman, deals 500% ATK as Extra DMG). Before battle begins, [Encourage] allies (gain 2 energy at the start of the round, lasting 3 rounds). Triggers [Resurrection] after taking fatal DMG (while an ally is present, recovers 60% HP before action, up to 3 times).

skills.name: 5★ Passive
skills.desc: [Specialized Acceleration] SPD +25% > +30%. [Encourage] duration 3 > 5 rounds. [Resurrection] up to 3 > 4 times.

skills.name: Awaken 1 Passive
skills.desc: Before battle begins, [Encourage] the allies (gains 2 energy at the start of the round, lasts 3 rounds). Triggers [Resurrection] after receiving fatal damage (When ally is present, recovers 60% HP before action, up to 3 times)

skills.name: Awaken 2 Passive
skills.desc: Encourage allies 2 energy > 3 energy Last 3 rounds > 5 rounds Trigger Resurrection 3x > 4x

effects.desc: The revive/return mechanism is tied to the life of the ally, bringing the unit back into the match.
Status returns downed units to battle, granting a limited number of respawns that anti-revive effects can remove.
Speed ​​buff that while in effect allows the bearer and up to 6 allies to act against and overcome enemies with lower speed.
